view.scene_description: The image shows the interior of a convenience store, focusing on multiple refrigerated beverage coolers filled with various drinks. Above the coolers are red promotional posters with Chinese text and images. The perspective is slightly tilted, capturing shelves and glass doors of the coolers. Lighting reflects off the glass surfaces, creating glare.

objects.label: refrigerated beverage cooler
objects.observation: A large, multi-door refrigerator unit filled with colorful bottled and canned beverages. It has glass doors with metal frames and is positioned centrally in the frame. The interior lighting illuminates the products inside. It is mounted to the wall or floor, though mounting details are not visible.

objects.label: refrigerated beverage cooler
objects.observation: A tall, narrow refrigerator unit with glass doors on the right side of the image. It contains various bottles and cans, with bright reflections on its surface. It appears to be mounted to the wall or floor, but specific mounting hardware is not visible.

objects.label: promotional poster
objects.observation: A rectangular red poster with white and yellow graphics and Chinese characters, mounted above the central cooler. It features an image of a beverage bottle and text promoting '果粒好味道' (fruit granule good taste). The poster is affixed to the wall above the coolers.

objects.label: promotional poster
objects.observation: Another rectangular red poster with white and blue graphics and Chinese characters, mounted above the right-side cooler. It displays an image of a person holding a bottle and text promoting '时刻纯净 好状态相伴' (always pure, good state accompanies). The poster is affixed to the wall above the cooler.

objects.label: bottled beverages
objects.observation: Numerous bottles of various colors and shapes visible inside the coolers, arranged on shelves. They include clear, green, yellow, and red bottles, indicating different drink types. Some bottles are partially obscured by reflections or other bottles.

objects.label: canned beverages
objects.observation: Multiple rows of canned beverages visible inside the coolers, primarily in silver, red, and blue colors. They are arranged neatly on shelves behind the glass doors. Some cans are partially obscured by other items or reflections.

prompts.native_chat_prompt_text:
<|im_start|>system
You are a helpful assistant<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>user
<|vision_start|><|image_pad|><|vision_end|>Inspect the photograph. Return ONLY one JSON object, no markdown or text outside JSON. Describe the complete scene and list visible objects with separate local integer IDs, separating instances when possible. For every object describe visible appearance, image-relative location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relationships. State uncertainty; do not infer hidden fasteners, weight or permanent installation. Do not classify stability or mobility. Use English text.
Required JSON structure (the angle-bracket text specifies field meaning, not example objects):
{"scene_description":"<full scene description>","objects":[{"id":1,"label":"<visible object name>","observation":"<visible appearance, location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relations>","attachment_evidence":"not_visible","identifiable":true}]}
List all discernible objects, not just one. Every object needs these five fields. attachment_evidence must be visible_installation, appears_freestanding, not_visible or mixed; visible_installation requires visible mounting or integration. Use not_visible when attachment cannot be established. scene_description about 120 words or fewer; each observation about 60 words or fewer.

Describe the photograph using these inputs:
{"frame_id": "thud_dense_test50/image-000045", "image_size": [960, 540], "annotation_kind": "unspecified", "supplied_objects": null}<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>assistant
